scope: Remote full-q trajectory export preflight with exact G1 and bilateral Sharpa assets
summary: The first 660-frame full-q run stopped before inference because the left Sharpa MJCF asset was absent on the remote host; the entry point correctly refused a partial or substituted embodiment.
evidence: The remote runtime verified OpenCV 4.11.0, MediaPipe 0.10.21, MuJoCo 3.3.7, NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.15.3, the 660-frame source, and available A800 capacity.
The preflight raised ValueError: sharpa_left_model does not exist before processing a frame or writing a trajectory manifest.
The exact left model registry hash is 3cbeb46259d4ba63cbdb83085255d1a8f8031c51e0101a6622f6e7e81a64dc11; no right-hand or simplified substitute was accepted.
lessons: Asset completeness and hash lineage must be checked before pose inference, even when the missing component is visually symmetric.
A failed remote asset transfer is infrastructure evidence, not a partial robot trajectory.
limitations: No generalized-coordinate estimate was produced by this attempt.
The remote asset checkout still needed a complete pinned left-hand mesh set.
next_actions: Complete the pinned SSH checkout, verify both Sharpa hashes, and rerun the immutable full-q experiment in a new directory.
